title: Jungle Expedition

reviewPolicy.reason: Player visual judgment remains authoritative. This atmosphere and ecology pass does not close the active 10/10 Island 018 goal.

viteProductionBuild.notes: Existing mixed static/dynamic import and large chunk warnings remain; the build completed successfully.

implementedVisualSystems: raised continuous jungle floor that surrounds the preserved Lost City crag and reads as a rooted temple mesa
six procedural river branches with authored bank/current/shallow vertex colours and animated in-memory water texture
3.45-unit camera-facing stream, 2.55-unit reflective lagoon, broadened hero cascade, reactive foam and rain roughness

eight route-clear procedural ground species: red-eyed tree frog, emerald iguana, lowland tapir, white-faced capuchin, keel-billed toucan, Amazon river turtle, golden poison dart frog, and ring-tailed coati
eighteen animated aerial animals spanning scarlet macaws, toucans, hummingbirds, blue morphos, golden parakeets, and dragonflies
180-second weather story with long clear rest, gradual cloud gathering, storm darkening, rain, two lightning beats, sunbreak, and slow clear recovery
rounded world-space procedural cloud volumes plus one reusable rain, lightning, and parallel sun-shaft line field
weather-reactive sky, canopy, mist, foam, water, sunlight, wildlife sheltering, and reduced-motion clear-rest behavior

evidence.proves: clear overview, broadened cascade, grounded foreground, readable ground wildlife, and active aerial fauna
dark rain state, rounded cloud massing, preserved temple readability, and fauna remaining alive during weather
clear blue recovery and a multi-height flock crossing the Lost City crown

knownCaptureNotes: All added sky, clouds, fauna, rain, lightning, sun shafts, rivers, and lagoon surfaces are procedural Three.js geometry or in-memory textures; no new image-mapped scenery was introduced.
The weather field is hidden during clear rest, so the clear overview avoids its draw call.
Earlier pass-08 captures are retained as iteration evidence but are not listed as final proof.
The persistent 10/10 production goal remains active for further whole-island refinement and player judgment.
